title: Research provenance
description: Who did each role on one dossier, on which model and effort. A value nobody recorded is "unknown", never a guess. check-research.mjs enforces this without a schema library.

dossier.description: The dossier's file name, next to this folder.

model.description: The exact model ID the session reports, not a marketing name.

harness.description: The tool and version, and whether it ran as a subagent.

brief.description: Path to the committed brief, relative to this folder, or unknown.

requested.description: What the agent that started this role asked for. When it differs from model or effort, notes says why.

disposition.description: fact-check only: the file where each finding is fixed, disputed or accepted.
